name: air_intercept_grounded_car_under_a_high_ball_earns_nothing
description: The car idles on the ground right under a ball at z 1200 that falls for 15 steps (1 s, to about z 875). A grounded car has carFrac 0, so Phi is (almost) 0 for the whole run: the car rests at z 17.04, so carFrac is about 1e-4 and the sum is a few 1e-6: parking under a dropping ball pays nothing. The ball starts with a 1 uu/s upward velocity on purpose: in the engine a ball set with EXACTLY zero velocity in the air does not fall (it floats, measured), while any nonzero velocity makes it fall normally. Training's state setters all give the ball a random nonzero velocity.

expect.intent: a car that stays on the floor earns nothing (under 5e-5 in all) whatever the ball does
